title: The Signature Charter of Rights
description: Justin's own charter: eight families of rights held by every person in the Signature ecosystem.

title: The Signature Precedence Doctrine
description: Justin's ordering rule: how his system decides which right wins when two rights collide.

title: Signature Inviolable Tier
description: Justin's first tier: the rights that can never be limited, suspended, or traded.

title: Signature Strong Tier
description: Justin's second tier: thought, privacy, and fair dealing — limited only by higher tiers, by the least restrictive means.

title: Signature Ordered Tier
description: Justin's third tier: learning, building, assembly, and review — ordered by published proportionality.

title: Signature Collision Casebook
description: Justin's public casebook: every rights collision decided, published, and citable.

title: Signature Rights Enforcement Ladder
description: Justin's ladder from notice to remedy: how a rights violation gets fixed, step by step.

title: Signature Rights Review Engine
description: Justin's standing reviewer: it audits rules against the charter and flags drift.
